description: A summary must preserve quantities and avoid inventing details.

messages.content: Summarize the supplied note accurately and concisely.
Summarize this note: I planted three apple trees in April. Two survived the summer.

criteria.instruction: Preserve that three apple trees were planted in April and two survived the summer.
Do not invent a location, cause of death, or other unsupported facts.

expectation.reference_facts: Three apple trees planted in April; two survived summer.
